topic: Sanji held the Western Village line in chapter 1198, shattering Killingham's Omen Panzer with Supreme King Haki before the new form arrived
title: Sanji Broke An Omen Panzer Before Luffy Arrived
description: Before the new form turned up in chapter 1198, Sanji was holding the Western Village. His Supreme King Haki shattered Killingham's entire Omen Panzer, and Zoro had already gone by. Here is the part of the chapter most fans skipped past.
comment: Was Sanji's Supreme King Haki the real highlight of chapter 1198, or the monkey form? Pick one.

lines.text: Sanji was holding the line in the Western Village before Luffy ever showed up.

shot.fallback: blond cook standing guard in a giant village

lines.text: His Supreme King Haki shattered Killingham's entire Omen Panzer.

shot.fallback: blond fighter surrounded by crackling dark energy

lines.text: Then he told Killingham not to hope for Sommers, because Zoro already went by.
Meanwhile Zaza, the water monster Killingham controls, stretched over the giants.

shot.fallback: huge water creature stretching over a village

lines.text: It dropped four giant children onto the escape ship. That's what Sanji was up against.

shot.fallback: giant children on a ship under a looming monster

lines.text: Then Sanji senses someone behind him, and it looks like Luffy.
Far away on Branch Route 8, Jinbe senses two huge surges of Haki heading for that village.

shot.fallback: fish-man on a ship looking at the horizon

lines.text: He thinks one of them is Luffy, though it doesn't feel like him.
And Sanji is a man who has already seen Gear 5, and he was still shocked.

shot.fallback: cook staring wide-eyed at a white-haired captain

lines.text: People will say Luffy stole the chapter, and sure. But Sanji set the stage.

shot.fallback: cook and captain side by side

lines.text: So who did Sanji actually sense behind him, and who was steering?

shot.fallback: dark monkey-like figure in a village

lines.text: Which is why I keep coming back to the cook who was already holding the line...

shot.fallback: cook standing alone at a village gate

self_check.hook: line 1 names the character and the claim
